defense_news.title: Russia raises 2027 military spending by 27%, budget documents show
defense_news.summary: Russia plans to spend 17.1 trillion roubles, or $202 billion, on defense in 2027, a 27% increase.

defense_news.title: EU nails down five defense priority areas to channel common spending
defense_news.summary: Drones, counter-drone tech, air defense, seabed defense and eastern flank protection top the EU's list of desired capability areas.

defense_news.title: UK’s Healey puts defense in focus for reindustrialization push
defense_news.summary: British government leaders are converging around the message that the defense sector will be key in energizing the nation's anemic growth.

defense_news.title: Terror suspects wanted to do ‘big damage’ to air base used by US, Trump says
defense_news.summary: British police on Sunday arrested five men on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offenses near an air base that hosts U.S. Air Force personnel.

geo_news.title: Muhsin Yazıcıoğlu'nun ölümüne ilişkin soruşturma kapsamında 36 şüpheli tutuklandı
